items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: I first knew him when he came east with Mom Waters. She had an orchestra... That's one of the first times I saw Don Byas.

ctx.x: Did you -- We didn't touch on Don Byas. When did you ever know Don Byas?
Don Byas? I knew Don Byas. He was from California. I first knew him when he came east with Mom Waters. She had an orchestra, and Eddie --
